candidate_source.title: Iwasawa theory of CM elliptic curves at potentially supersingular primes
candidate_source.disposition: The literal displayed transition is not imported: its binomial substitution and quartic leading coefficient fail the native checks. CM arithmetic identification does not apply to this non-CM curve. No general rejection of other results is claimed.

deduction_boundary: Lean proves exact polynomial and rational coefficient algebra, degree controls and a uniform norm-sign repair implication. Actual local fields, infinite compatible root-of-unity and uniformizer towers, valuation/divergence arguments and field norm are written mathematics. Multiplicative field norm is not additive elliptic trace; signed generators, actual local pairing and determinant normalization remain open.
